answer: I never drink coffee in the evening because it keeps me awake.
other_correct: I drink coffee in the evening because it never keeps me awake.
instruction_problem: Ambiguous: 'never' also fits in the because-clause (it never keeps me awake), which is logical and different in meaning; the instruction does not say which meaning is wanted. Also the because-clause is not needed to place 'never' in the main clause; the sentence invites the second reading. Never do I drink... (inversion) needs added 'do', so not possible.
